description: Department of Local Government - North Western Province - The meeting the Purpose of electing the Vice Chairman for the Panduwasnuwara Predeshiya Sabha at 10.00 a.m. on 18.08.2021
reasoning: This gazette notice announces the schedule for a meeting to elect the vice chairman of the Panduwasnuwara Pradeshiya Sabha, which falls under electoral processes for local government authorities. It is published under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance and its amendments, making it clearly related to election matters.
